0022600033.text: The San Antonio Spurs (6-2, sixth in the West and 0.5 games back of first in the Southwest) make the road trip to the Sacramento Kings (1-7) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C regular-season game, their ninth of the season, with a six-game winning streak and a 2-0 road record. Sacramento is 15th in the West and 0-3 at home after a loss, and it will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Daeqwon Plowden (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while the Spurs are missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain). San Antonio leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 130-103 win in San Antonio on October 27, and it won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season.
